The failures are in `test_pop_returns_falsy_items` / `test_falsy_items_keep_round_robin_order`, which specifically test that popping an empty-bytes item (`b""`) works correctly. The queue is currently treating `b""` as "empty" and returning `None` instead. Deleting or skipping these tests would silently hide a real correctness bug (falsy-but-valid queue items getting silently dropped), so let me look at the actual source first.

The rest of the codebase (`queue.py:21`) already uses `is not None` as the correct empty-sentinel check, so I made `rrqueue.py` consistent with that. One-line fix, suite is now fully green.
